verdict.rationale: The evidence only documents keyboard navigation to customer pages: G then Q opens the customer list, and O then Q lets you search by customer name. That is a related but different feature, not jumping to feedback items, tasks or initiatives by short name. No evidence covers short-name or identifier jump-to for issues or initiatives, so the related customer shortcut earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump directly to any feedback item, task, or initiative by typing its short name
